content:
Laredo got a little greener on Saturday. The City of Laredo celebrated Arbor Day at Divine Mercy Park, where 280 volunteers planted 259 trees across the park.

The celebration also included a ribbon-cutting ceremony hosted by District 6 Council Member Dr. Tyler King, marking new improvements at the park — new trees, a solar pergola donated by PEG Energy, newly installed electric vehicle charging stations, and other upgrades.

The city thanked the volunteers, sponsors, and community partners who made the morning possible, saying the effort helps Laredo grow, one tree at a time.

Source: City of Laredo — Government, Facebook, November 7, 2026.
